subject: simple scheduler out of sync with page reload?

messages.author: 8e72bac5f7bfb16e
messages.subject: simple scheduler out of sync with page reload?
parts:
If I set simple_scheduler=1 in my configuration file it works fine: one user can go to the server, the second user gets the 'too many users' message.

If, however, my first user reloads the page, he/she gets the 'too many users message'.

Seems a brief problem, since hitting the reload button again (right away) loads the page without a problem.

Is there any trick to have a page reload reset shiny's notion of how many users there are (to one less)?
